label_rule: 1 only same explicitly requested and reported direct field;0other direct field;null derived/diagnostic/broader or unbound. False claims of relevant field remain relevant.
population_recipe: Every153pairs perfixture:bothquerylanguages,bothrequestedfields,bothreportedfields,measured/value-swap variants; then every18fields x3semanticUNKNOWN kinds x2querylanguages and2structuralUNKNOWN. Same established row envelope/projection; aliases/captions/questions frozen here.
numeric_balance: Each query/competing pair has identical value multiset for positive and negative through measured/value-swap variants. No label/truth/role annotation in model inputs.
wording: Two newly authored semantic bases per role/language/axis, four surface renderings;32alias/caption/report-language combinations independently shuffled and repeated twice across64fixtures. Both query languages on everyfixture. Same known envelope/primitive meanings, lexical confirmation only.
seed101_reuse: Already completed audited immutable derivative and validation-only cutoffs; no repeated identical training.202/303new adaptations from same base/unchanged original train and validation.
confirmation_gate: Everyseed,aggregate,EN/PTquery,EN/PTreport,unseen-pair and seen-wording-control slices; no mean rescuing failure. Unknown rows shared in slice calculations, forwards counted only once.
scalar_control: Immutable prior ordering only, no trained support/DROP authority
scope: 64fresh authored actual-tool fixtures; all18fields/3tools known.101newcross-tool pair combinations plus52known-pair wording controls. Correlated cases, no new domain/production/human/P2/LCC usefulness certification.
